title: 第15章 云鹤珏结丹修为被斩筑基
novel_title: 开局暴打渣男，我带九个道侣飞升
content_zh:
原主最初遇到云鹤珏时，他便是筑基中期修为。

    要不是为了瑶池颜面，路仙瑶哪能如此轻易便宜了他？

    既然他拿不出来那些宝贝了，那就自斩修为，恢复出厂设置，这个还算合理。

    一个吃软饭都吃不明白的人，得让他知道，这软饭，不是谁都能吃得了的。

    闻言，路青梧和九个炉鼎同时看向她。

    她来真的？

    “什么？！”

    云鹤珏如遭雷击，眼中满是惊愕，“路仙瑶，你让我自斩修为，回到筑基？不可能！这绝不可能！”

    凝结金丹何其艰难修为，稍有不慎，修为倒退不止，若是路仙瑶那庞大的资源，他根本结不了丹。

    斩回筑基？

    这意味着他将彻底失去如今的实力、地位、尊严！

    这比杀了他还难受百倍千倍！

    这路仙瑶竟如此歹毒，用这样的法子折磨他？

    而且，重修之路何其艰难？

    没有了瑶池的庞大资源，他如何还能重回结丹？

    “这不行，那也不行的，云鹤珏，你当我是在与你商量吗？既然两者你都不肯……”

    跟他拉扯这么久，路仙瑶早就没有耐心了，她看向路青梧，“青梧哥，放剑……”

    “且慢！”

    风清子站出来。

    路仙瑶看向他，“风长老，可是愿替你的徒弟常还？”

    风清子面上窘迫，“圣女，你也知道，我天鸣剑宗底蕴不如瑶池圣地，你送的那些东西……鹤珏确实一时半会拿不出来……”

    “所以啊，我让他自斩修为，此事便揭过。”

    风清子深深地叹了口气，痛心疾首道：“那……由老夫来吧，毕竟是孽徒闯下的祸事…”

    路仙瑶没有想到，他这师尊还算有担当，倒是对他有几分刮目相看。

    而云鹤珏也是与她一样的心情，方才他还对师尊产生了一丝不敬……当真是羞愧！

    风清子看向云鹤珏，“鹤珏，你莫要怪为师，为师这么做，也是为了宗门着想……”
content_en:
When the original owner first met Yun Hejue, he was in the middle stage of foundation building.

    If it weren't for Yaochi's face, how could Lu Xianyao take advantage of him so easily?

    Since he can't take out those treasures, it is reasonable to cut off his own cultivation and restore the factory settings.

    A person who cannot understand how to eat soft food must be made aware that not everyone can eat this soft food.

    Hearing this, Lu Qingwu and Nine Furnace Cauldrons looked at her at the same time.

    Is she serious?

    "What?!"

    Yun Hejue felt as if he had been struck by lightning, his eyes full of astonishment, "Lu Xianyao, you want me to cut off my own cultivation and return to foundation building? Impossible! This is absolutely impossible!"

    It is extremely difficult to cultivate the golden elixir. If you are not careful, your cultivation will continue to regress. If Lu Xianyao had such huge resources, he would not be able to form the elixir at all.

    Cut back to the foundation?

    This means that he will completely lose his current strength, status, and dignity!

    This is a hundred times more uncomfortable than killing him!

    How could Xianyao be so vicious and torture him in such a way?

    Moreover, how difficult is the road to rebuilding?

    Without the huge resources of Yaochi, how could he return to Danjie?

    "This won't work, and that won't work either. Yun Hejue, do you think I'm negotiating with you? Since you are unwilling to do both..."

    After fighting with him for so long, Lu Xianyao had long lost her patience. She looked at Lu Qingwu and said, "Brother Qingwu, release the sword..."

    "Wait!"

    Feng Qingzi stood up.

    Lu Xianyao looked at him, "Elder Feng, are you willing to pay for your apprentice?"

    Feng Qingzi looked embarrassed, "Holy girl, you also know that the foundation of our Tianming Sword Sect is not as good as that of the Yaochi Holy Land. Those things you gave... He Jue will indeed not be able to get them out for a while..."

    "So, I let him kill himself to cultivate, and the matter will be revealed."

    Feng Qingzi sighed deeply and said sadly: "Then... let me do it. After all, it was the miscreants who caused the trouble..."

    Lu Xianyao did not expect that his master was quite responsible, but he was somewhat impressed by him.

    And Yun Hejue felt the same as her. Just now he had a hint of disrespect towards the master... He was really ashamed!

    Feng Qingzi looked at Yun Hejue and said, "Hejue, don't blame me. Master, I did this for the sake of the sect..."
title_en: Chapter 15 Yun Hejue’s alchemy cultivation was cut off to build the foundation
